temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn has been unusually quiet and withdrawn over the past few days during a busy, stressful week at the bank. When Carolyn asks if she is alright, Marilyn says she is overwhelmed by work and personal stuff and thanks her for asking.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Marilyn is normally engaging; her recent quietness is uncharacteristic, so something may be wrong, but Carolyn does not know the cause.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Marilyn confirms she is overwhelmed by work and personal issues rather than merely being quiet.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn is dealing with significant work and personal stress and may need support, though she has not shared details.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Offer a listening ear and support Marilyn without prying.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After Carolyn's initial approach, Marilyn was curt in a later interaction, leaving Carolyn confused and slightly hurt. Carolyn shares her own tough experiences and hopes she did not overstep. Marilyn apologizes and says it has just been a hard week.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believes Marilyn may be upset with her or that her earlier support was unwelcome, because Marilyn's curtness seems personal despite Marilyn's earlier explanation of stress.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Marilyn's apology and explanation clarify that her curtness was likely due to a hard week, not a rejection of Carolyn or her support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn is receptive to Carolyn's support and is struggling with stress; the tension is probably not personal.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Relieved and reassured, with lingering empathy after confusion and hurt.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Continue to show support and understanding while being careful not to overstep.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn appears to have responded positively to Carolyn's openness. Carolyn invites Marilyn to a small weekend get-together, and Marilyn says it sounds lovely, thanks her, and accepts.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn feels relieved and hopeful after Marilyn's positive response; she believes Marilyn may be open to a budding friendship.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Marilyn's acceptance confirms that she is willing to socialize outside work and strengthen the connection.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn is interested in spending time together and may be becoming a friend.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Follow through with the gathering and build a stronger friendship with Marilyn.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Despite friendly interactions outside work, Carolyn perceives that Marilyn still maintains a professional distance at the bank. When Carolyn raises this, Marilyn says she did not realize it, apologizes if it seemed that way, and agrees they should talk and improve collaboration.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believes they are building a friendship outside work, but Marilyn's continued professional distance at the bank makes her feel disappointed and uncertain about Marilyn's willingness to be closer at work.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Marilyn was unaware of the perceived distance and is open to discussing and improving their work dynamic.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: The distance may be unintended or resolvable; Marilyn is cooperative, so Carolyn can address their professional relationship directly.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Disappointed before the exchange, then cautiously relieved and hopeful.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Have a private conversation about their work dynamic and clarify professional expectations and boundaries to improve collaboration.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After their private meeting, Carolyn believes they have cleared the air and better understand each other's professional expectations and personal boundaries. She proposes teaming up on the new project proposal; Marilyn says it is a great idea, is glad they talked, and looks forward to working more closely.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believes they have resolved earlier tensions and understand each other's professional expectations and personal boundaries; she feels content and optimistic.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: No major change; Marilyn's enthusiastic agreement confirms and strengthens Carolyn's belief that they can collaborate well.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Carolyn believes their partnership is stronger, mutually understood, and ready for closer collaboration.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Team up with Marilyn on the new project proposal and work closely together.
